findings.sourceReading: 意味を込めていた says she invested the act of unlocking with the meaning of releasing herself from the restrictions of human toxin. This explains why she chose this particular prank.

contexts.japanesePS3: カップの中にキャンディを現す魔法については、マリア卿に、手品であっても魔法だと誤解する可能性があることが示されマシタ。

findings.sourceReading: マリア卿に ... 誤解する可能性があることが示されました says it has been demonstrated that Maria can mistake even a trick for magic. The established fact is a possibility of misinterpretation in Maria.

Nevertheless Lady MARIA has been shown makes her the recipient of a demonstration and presents the object as possibly a trick she misunderstood, rather than expressly demonstrating her susceptibility.
